title: Software Engineer Manager II, Full Stack
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role you will help evolve our infrastructure to unlock future Search product innovation with focus areas of improved reliability, velocity, and sustainability. Work at the very center of Search, helping engineers across numerous teams align our platform evolution with Search's broader architectural efforts by collaborating with other infrastructure partner teams and Search feature teams. Across all these projects, collaboration is key. Search Infrastructure is a large system, and success relies on partnering across different teams.

Join Google Search AI and work at the intersection of industry leading
global scale. We apply breakthrough research, leveraging models like Gemini, to launch high-impact products that help billions ask any question and get things done. If you want to drive the future of AI in Search and work with world-class experts to deliver tangible, global impact and continuous innovation, this is the place.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams.
  • Design, guide, and vet systems designs within the scope of the broader area, and write product or system development code to solve ambiguous problems.
  • Develop the mid-term technical goal and roadmap within the scope of your (often multiple) team(s). Evolve the roadmap to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs.
  • Set clear expectations with individuals based on their level and role, and aligned to the broader organization's goals.
  • Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development, and provide feedback and coaching.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 3 years of experience with full stack development, across back-end such as Java, Python, Golang, or C++ codebases, and front-end experience including JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or equivalent.
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
  • 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or related technical field.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization.

title: Senior Software Engineering Manager, Platforms Infrastructure Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will join the Machine Repairs team to take control of the largest data center footprint in the world. You will be responsible for delivering reliable compute and storage for use by all Google products and cloud customers. You will own the overarching technical strategy and multi-quarter roadmap to maximize accelerator availability and minimize operational disruption across massive fleets of custom TPU pods and cutting-edge GPU clusters.

You will govern operational reliability and Service Level Agreements across critical services. You will oversee system architecture, CI/CD automation, and precision testing standards to ensure scalable, secure platform performance.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams. 
  • Develop the long-term technical goal and roadmap within, and often beyond, the scope of your teams. Evolve the roadmap to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs. 
  • Oversee systems designs within the scope of the broader area, and review products. Evaluate trade-offs across micro-services, distributed systems, event-driven designs, and data platforms without micromanaging code. Manage cross-functional dependencies across product, design, data, infrastructure, and security teams.
  • Interface with Global Hardware Engineering and R&D teams to provide closed-loop telemetry and failure feedback, influencing future hardware revisions and field modularity.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 7 years of experience building and developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage, or hardware architecture.
  • 5 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
  • 5 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 15 years of experience in software development, architecture, and technology leadership.
  • Experience building and maintaining infrastructure systems for enterprise applications and AI/ML.
  • Experience building and maintaining distributed systems for large-scale AI/ML applications.

title: Solution Architect, Capital Markets and Exchanges, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you will operate within the Innovation team, the Capital Markets and Exchanges Solution Architect collaborates with clients to transform initial concepts into reality. You will collaborate in strategic business transformations through designing and architecting cutting-edge solutions across all aspects of trade processing: clearing, issuance, settlement, custody and post trade processing. You will be a trusted advisor to our customers in helping them shape their future through the latest Technologies, tokenization platforms and the flexibility of scaling cloud to enable latency sensitive trading with your deep knowledge of the business, current and horizon technologies.

In this role, you will be an independent, highly motivated and opinionated problem solver, innovator, and builder, able to learn, influence and build trust with a highly complex financial institution. You will be expected to advise on best practices across business and technology to realize innovative solutions using the latest cloud technologies.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €148000 - €151000 (EUR) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Design and architect solutions such as scalable position-keeping services, hybrid financial instruments handling, low latency and stream solutions for trading exchanges.
  • Evaluate and integrate solutions with modern data foundations, including Relational Databases, Data Lake Houses, and real-time streaming architectures, ensuring data pipelines are optimized for AI retrieval, agentic workflows, and real-time financial insights.
  • Partner with client leads(business user) to create Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), clearly defining Critical User Journeys (CUJs) and success metrics.
  • Create clear technical guides to ensure a seamless hand-off from Point of Contact to engineering teams.
  • Build reusable Proof-of-Concept and MVP code, documentation, presentations demonstrating reworld solutions using Google Cloud Platform.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of Capital Markets and Exchanges experience designing and architecting solutions for issuance, clearing, trading, settlement, custody, reference, and market data.
  • 4 years of experience in software or data engineering with one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, Go, or Java), including experience with design patterns, testing frameworks, and API contract design.
  • Experience in Financial Services, including experience with the regulatory and operational rigors of clearing, settlement, or custody.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience designing and implementing smart contracts within regulated Financial Market Infrastructures (FMIs). This includes managing the life-cycle of tokenized assets.
  • Experience working in a high-maturity DevOps culture (trunk-based development, automated testing, blue/green deployments).
  • Proficient in BigQuery, Vertex AI, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub.
  • Understanding of data residency, encryption at rest/transit (CMEK), and "Explainable AI" requirements in banking.
  • Strong understanding of relational, NoSQL, and analytical data modeling (Star Schema, Data Vault, etc.).
  • Ability to independently drive the discovery phase, moving from a vague business problem to a structured PRD and a working technical demo.

title: Manager, AI and Infrastructure, Strategic Initiatives (Korean, English)
descriptionHtml:
Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.

The AI and Infrastructure (AI2) Strategy and Operations team drives operational excellence, executive enablement, and strategic alignment across AI and Infrastructure.

In this role, you will bridge executive goal and engineering execution, governing cross-functional initiatives, optimizing critical resourcing, and accelerating the planetary-scale delivery of next-generation AI platforms.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Drive strategic partnership development with Korean memory manufacturers and ecosystem leaders to secure High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) and next-gen memory capacity.
  • Lead execution for TPU APAC expansion in Korea, advancing localized sovereign AI compute initiatives, TPU deployment models, and first-party data center builds.
  • Align senior stakeholders across Amin Vahdat's AI2 Engineering teams, hardware procurement, and product managers to synchronize memory technology roadmaps with AI hardware platforms.
  • Establish regional working groups to address critical supply chain vulnerabilities, technological transitions (e.g., HBM4, CXL), and memory scaling requirements.
  • Deliver comprehensive intelligence on Korean memory market dynamics and technical developments to advise and empower Google's systems architecture teams.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 11 years of experience in business development, semiconductor supply chain management, partnerships, or hardware operations.
  • Experience working with executives, and leading cross-functional hardware or technology projects.
  • Ability to communicate in Korean and English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in the semiconductor memory ecosystem (HBM, DRAM, NAND), packaging architectures, and AI infrastructure design requirements.
  • Ability to manage high-value technology agreements and joint strategic initiatives with major Korean industrial partners.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguous environments, influence leaders across functions, and deliver strategic results under tight timelines.

title: Performance Automation Specialist, Financial Services
descriptionHtml:
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

As a Performance Specialist in Financial Services, you will be the primary architect of Search growth for our largest partners, playing a critical role in the Total Opportunity Google will bring to grow ad customers' business. You will lead the evolution of Search, leveraging Google’s AI products and solutions to solve customer business challenges and unlock growth.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $124000 - $180000 (USD) + 60% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Drive impact for our largest ads customers by activating Google’s performance-centric solutions, including AI targeting and creatives (AI Max for Search, Performance Max), advanced bidding strategies, and demand-led budgets, tailored for large-scale ads customers.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to sales teams, ads customers, and agencies, translating complex performance data into actionable business insights and long-term roadmaps to improve Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Embrace challenger selling in a competitive environment, leading with Google’s “Best AI for the Best ROI” performance outlook.
  • Partner with front-line sales teams, internal technical teams, and other specialist experts to drive business outcomes for ads customers.
  • Test and scale new product launches, and partner with Product and Engineering teams to provide feedback from the Finance industry, influencing the next generation of Search solutions.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in digital media, sales, marketing, or product roles, or 6 years of experience with an advanced degree.
  • Experience with search advertising.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in a client-facing role, with a track record of building long-term relationships and influencing complex decision-making processes with executive stakeholders (client and agency).
  • Advanced knowledge of Google Ads, AI-powered bidding solutions (e.g., AI Max, Performance Max), and performance channel measurement.
  • Understanding of the Financial Services industry.
  • Track record of working across cross-functional teams (Sales, Product, and Marketing) to drive unified goals.
  • Ability to lead challenging sales conversations that uncover opportunity, increase business, and build partnership.

title: Data Center Facilities Technician
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components).

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $105000 - $145000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components. 
  • Provide daily assistance to technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems, and assess their working order.
  • Manage the uptime and maintenance of water pumps and treatment systems, HVAC, UPS, generators, electrical distribution, and control and monitoring systems.
  • Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions in the data center facilities systems and equipment.
  • Support startup, commissioning, and integration of new equipment and systems into facilities infrastructure.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of Mechanical Infrastructure Systems, Mechanical Maintenance/Testing, Electrical Infrastructure Systems, Safety and Maintenance, Mission Critical Systems, Control Panels, Generators, Controllers or Controls/Automation experience in an industrial/commercial environment.
  • Ability to participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, the required use of OSHA standard safety equipment such as limited weight bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools and personal protective equipment (PPE) like safety harnesses.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in data centers, hospitals, or power plants.
  • 5 years of Electrical, Mechanical/HVAC, or controls/automation, or construction/technical environment or a related field.
  • Knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., Feeders, Transformers, Generators, Switchgear, UPS systems, ATS/STS units, PDU/PMM units, Chillers, Air handling units, and CRAC units).
  • Knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment.
  • Ability to communicate with contractors who perform maintenance or upgrade work on the data center systems.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Network Observability

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Customers use our products for network monitoring, security analysis, forensics and cost optimization.

Our work combines large-scale, real-time data processing with customer-facing product design, so engineers see their impact directly in how enterprises run their networks. We are enthusiastic about AI and use it every day to build and operate our products.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

  • Design, build, and launch features for Google Cloud network observability products such as VPC Flow Logs, Cloud Next Generation Firewall logging, and Cloud NAT logging.
  • Write and test code for large-scale, real-time data processing systems that turn network telemetry into logs and metrics customers rely on.
  • Work with product managers and partner engineering teams to understand customer needs and turn them into technical designs.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Networking, Hybrid Connectivity
descriptionHtml:
Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We deliver zero-friction, mission-critical hybrid connectivity (Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN, and Cloud Router) through resilient, modern control-plane architectures (Arcus/Hybrid CLH), empowering global enterprises to connect to Google Cloud with predictable performance, carrier-grade reliability, and defense-in-depth security.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Drive technical initiatives for the Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN, and Cloud Router control plane within the Bengaluru Hybrid Connectivity team. Own end-to-end design, implementation, and deployment of reliable, scalable control-plane components and features.
  • Design and develop high-throughput, low-latency control-plane software for Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN, and Cloud Router. Translate product requirements into technical designs, ensuring seamless integration with Google Cloud's hybrid networking infrastructure.
  • Diagnose control-plane issues across distributed routing and virtual private network systems. Enhance observability, sub-second route convergence, fault tolerance, and system uptime to maintain enterprise-grade Service-Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Partner with Product Management, SRE, and partner engineering teams across global and local Bengaluru sites to align on technical dependencies and deliver high-performance hybrid connectivity solutions.

  • Experience with Software Defined Networking, Security, Networking, within Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or other public clouds like Cloud Computing Platform.
  • Experience with system automation, automated testing, or continuous deployment pipelines in a production environment.
  • Experience diagnosing and resolving complex, systemic troubleshooting issues in distributed control plane systems.
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex technical designs and collaborate effectively with adjacent engineering, product, and SRE teams.

title: Senior Staff Research Scientist, Google Research
descriptionHtml:
As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

Google Research is building the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. Google Research teams collaborate closely with other teams across Google, maintaining the flexibility and versatility required to adapt new projects and foci that meet the demands of the world's fast-paced business needs.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $262000 - $364000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Author research papers to share and generate impact of research results across organization and in the research community. 
  • Contribute to research growth by sharing research trends and best practices within the community by reviewing academic papers, serving on program committees and grant panels, speaking at Google events or research conferences, or organizing research conferences and visioning activities. 
  • Deliver full projects by defining the data structure, framework, design, and evaluation metrics for research solution development and implementation. Identify timelines and obtain resources needed. 
  • Identify new and upcoming research areas by interacting with potential external and internal collaborators. Own long-term research strategy and plans to expand the impact of Google research. 
  • Identify undefined problems in existing technology and engage stakeholders and leaders to address them.

Minimum qualifications:

  • PhD in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience with research agendas across multiple teams or projects.
  • One or more scientific publication submission(s) for conferences, journals, or public repositories.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 4 years of experience leading multiple research efforts and influencing research direction.
  • 2 years of coding experience.

title: Business Data Scientist, Internal Audit
descriptionHtml:
Internal Audit‘s mission is to focus on reducing risk across Alphabet. We do this by monitoring the risk environment across Alphabet and providing insights to enable effective risk management. We work closely with teams and leadership to achieve a strong control environment that enhances and protects organizational value. We serve as one of the company’s various lines of defense for staffing and developing our team to be control experts who deliver objective and reliable results. As a member of the team, you will advise the business and engineering groups to identify areas of risk and make valuable recommendations on controls. You will have the opportunity to influence change and decisions for business initiatives including product launches and system implementations. You enjoy working in a dynamic environment, are passionate about technology and are able to focus on key issues and the details that come with it.

As a Business Data Scientist within Internal Audit, you will lead complex analytical initiatives across Alphabet to quantify risk and evaluate controls at scale. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and business leadership to drive data-informed risk management decisions and build scalable data solutions to safeguard organizational value.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $138000 - $197000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with business, technology and privacy and security auditors, working closely with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Product Management, Operations and Finance to identify and quantify risk, as well as to evaluate controls at scale.
  • Analyze product, infrastructure and financial data for a variety of patterns including abuse, fraud, brand risk, control breakdown and regulatory non-compliance; succinctly calibrate and convey findings from your work to varied stakeholders.

descriptionHtml:

We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

title: Principal, Strategic Partnerships Lead, Modular Data Center Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:

By pushing system complexity upstream into factory environments, we enable rapid "square wave" capacity deployment—bringing AI compute, power, cooling, and network fabric online with speed. Operating at the intersection of AI Systems and Infrastructure (AI2), Google Data Centers (GDC), Systems and Manufacturing (ISM), and Google Global Infrastructure (GGI), our organization designs the modular product platform and executes the commercial, operational, and delivery strategies required to land technical infrastructure at gigawatt scale.

Operating in a high-growth, highly ambiguous space. You will design, originate, and execute commercial agreements and strategic partnerships.

In this individual contributor role, you will lead high-stakes negotiations with C-suite executives across global industrial manufacturers, modular fabricators, and engineering integrators. Your focus will be developing business partnerships to enable this strategic capability for Google. You will operate with executive autonomy, mobilizing and leading cross-functional agreement teams across Engineering, Hardware Supply Chain, Finance, and Legal to turn technical modular designs into legally binding, commercially sound global agreements.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

title: Physical Design Technical Lead, ASIC, TPU
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

Google’s Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) are incredibly complex, pushing the boundaries of physical design, power, and performance. In this role, you will provide technical leadership for the physical design of our next-generation AI silicon. Because of the sheer scale of our chips, our physical design leadership is highly dynamic; you will be expected to drive end-to-end execution with a scope that scales from owning highly complex, critical macro-subsystems up to overarching project-wide top-level implementation, depending on project needs.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead block-level and chip-level physical design execution—including floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), routing, power optimization, and physical/timing closure—across multiple design milestones.
  • Partner closely with RTL, DFT, Static Timing Analysis (STA), Power/IR-Drop, Packaging, and IP teams to resolve architectural bottlenecks, interface timing, and die-to-die/I/O integration challenges early in the design cycle.
  • Define technical execution plans, establish quality-of-results (QoR) targets, track design convergence, and proactively identify and mitigate schedule or technical risks ahead of major tapeout gates.
  • Oversee final signoff convergence across timing (STA), power integrity (EM/IR), physical verification (DRC/LVS/ANT), and reliability checks to ensure clean, on-schedule foundry handoff.
  • Provide technical guidance and design reviews for internal engineers and external design partners, while driving flow automation and methodology improvements to boost overall team productivity.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in physical design, including experience in ASIC physical design (RTL-to-GDSII) on advanced process nodes (e.g., 5nm, 3nm, 2nm, or equivalent FinFET/GAA technologies).
  • Experience leading physical implementation and successfully taping out multi-million-gate SoCs or high-performance compute chips.
  • Experience in industry-standard EDA tools for PnR, parasitic extraction, STA, EM/IR, and physical verification (e.g., Synopsys ICC2/Fusion Compiler, PrimeTime, StarRC, Cadence Innovus/Tempus, Calibre).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • Experience leading distributed engineering teams and collaborating closely with external vendor/partner teams during peak execution phases.
  • Experience in high-speed interface timing closure (e.g., die-to-die interconnects, SerDes/PHY, and I/O pad rings) and low-power design techniques (UPF/CPF).
  • Experience in scripting languages (Tcl, Python, Perl) for flow debugging, QoR analysis, and automation.

title: ASIC CAD IP Engineer, Cloud TPU
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

Every custom Google Cloud Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) begins with its physical building blocks—foundry Process Design Kits (PDKs), standard cell libraries, high-speed memories, and specialized third-party Intellectual Property (IP). As an Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) Computer-Aided Design (CAD) IP Engineer, you will sit at the intersection of external semiconductor ecosystems and Google's Artificial Intelligence (AI) hardware tapeouts.

Rather than managing silicon collateral manually, you will engineer automated Python and Tcl validation pipelines that transform foundry and vendor deliveries into clean, unified, production-ready releases. Your automation and quality gates directly safeguard multi-billion-transistor TPU schedules, catching cross-view discrepancies before they reach physical implementation and signoff. Because you will partner with Physical Design, Static Timing Analysis (STA), CAD Methodology, and foundry partners, this role offers an end-to-end view of advanced-node chip execution—with direct mentorship and room to grow your ownership across Google's silicon infrastructure.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $138000 - $197000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate incoming library and IP releases from foundry and EDA partners, building automated Python and Tcl workflows to ingest, standardize, and deploy deliverables across TPU projects ahead of project milestones.
  • Drive automated integrity checks and multi-view library validation across timing, power, physical, and layout views (.lib, .db, .ndm, .lef, .gds) using QA tools such as Siemens Solido Crosscheck, alongside Logic Equivalency Checking (LEC) via Synopsys Formality or Cadence Conformal to verify functional consistency across revisions.
  • Collaborate with Physical Design, STA, and CAD engineers to compile libraries, debug cross-view integration issues, and ensure smooth execution from early bring-up through tapeout.
  • Develop physical design PnR flows on leading technology nodes.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience with managing vendor engagements and library delivery schedules in an ASIC design environment.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering with an emphasis on VLSI, physical design, or EDA methodologies.
  • 3 years of experience in ASIC CAD/design enablement, foundation IP quality assurance, or physical implementation in advanced foundry nodes (e.g., TSMC).
  • Experience with library validation and compilation tools (e.g., Siemens Solido Crosscheck, Synopsys Library Compiler) across standard cell, memory, or macro libraries.
  • Experience in building physical design flows or working on physical design convergence
  • Track record of building automated scripts or release pipelines that standardize third-party collateral and prevent downstream design issues.
  • Interest in expanding technical scope across physical design flows, methodology automation, and custom silicon implementation.

title: Group Product Manager, Search Content Platform
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

In the AI era, users expect Search to effortlessly Answer, Explore, and Address Anything. To meet these rising expectations, our models need the content.

The Search Content Platform (SCP) team builds an AI-first content platform to deliver a comprehensive and trustworthy knowledge source. By acquiring third-party data and organizing disparate modalities—such as text, images, videos, and User-Generated Content—into a seamless whole, we make Search AI experiences rich, helpful, and performant.

Our team's mission is to use AI to revolutionize how we acquire and organize third-party content. As the Group Product Manager for Content Acquisition and Identity, you will manage a team to define the future of Google Search content. You will collaborate with engineering teams in Zurich, Sao Paulo, and Mountain View, and represent the organization to key partners.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the product goal, detailed platform requirements for a horizontal content acquisition platform that accelerates third-party (3P) content acquisition while delivering on critical priority verticals such as Sports and Health.
  • Enable Search to answer billions of user queries daily by innovating on content identity for the AI era and establishing clear, disambiguated, and precise identities for billions of user queries on Search daily.
  • Direct efforts to analyze billions of current and aspirational user queries that lack sufficient content, and prioritize or drive initiatives to bridge these gaps and improve product helpfulness to end users.
  • Discuss your knowledge and use of AI tools during the hiring process to demonstrate the AI fluency expected in this role.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
  • 5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
  • 5 years of experience in people management, with technical leadership.
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience balancing consumer reach with infrastructure constraints (cost, latency, and model optimization).
  • Experience in cross-functional leadership, and partnering with teams across organizational boundaries.
  • Familiarity with modern machine learning, LLMs, and foundational models (such as Gemini).

title: Data Center Facilities Technician, Mechanical
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components).

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $105000 - $145000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems such as piping and mechanical system components.
  • Provide daily assistance to technicians as you read blueprints/schematics/sequence of operations, conduct tours of systems, and assess their working order.
  • Manage the uptime and maintenance of water pumps and treatment systems, HVAC and control and monitoring systems.
  • Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions in the data center facilities systems and equipment.
  • Support startup, commissioning, and integration of new mechanical equipment and systems into facilities infrastructure.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of Mechanical/HVAC experience in an industrial or commercial environment.
  • Experience with Mechanical Maintenance, Mechanical Testing, HVAC, Chillers, Cooling Systems, data center Operations, Maintainability.
  • Ability to participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, the required use of OSHA standard safety equipment such as limited weight bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools and personal protective equipment like safety harnesses.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience in maintenance of mechanical/cooling distribution systems or construction/technical environment or a related field.
  • Experience in data centers, hospitals, or power plants.
  • Knowledge of mechanical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., Chillers, Air handling units, pumps and CRAC/CRAH units).
  • Knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment.
  • Ability to communicate with contractors who perform maintenance or upgrade work on the data center systems.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI (Thai, English)
descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:

title: Director, Engineering, Sovereign Environments, SRE, Cloud
descriptionHtml:
As part of Technical Infrastructure, Google’s Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is an engineering discipline for building and running large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. Our Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) come from both software engineering and systems engineering backgrounds and specialize in designing, building and maintaining large-scale production services. SRE ensures that Google’s services - both our internally critical and our externally visible systems - have reliability and uptime appropriate to users’ needs and a fast rate of improvement while keeping an ever-watchful eye on capacity and performance. Along with a set of engineering approaches, SRE is a mindset of running better production systems. We build our own creative engineering solutions to operations problems. Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. SRE is responsible for the big picture, determining how our systems relate to each other, using a breadth of tools and approaches to solve a broad spectrum of problems. Practices, such as limiting time spent on operational work, blameless postmortems and proactive identification of potential outages, factor into iterative improvement that is key to both product quality and interesting, dynamic day-to-day work. title: Forward Deployed Engineer V, GenAI, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Google Cloud’s Data Cloud team builds the data platform behind Google’s agentic AI offerings: BigQuery, Managed Spark, borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB and Knowledge Catalog, integrated with Gemini Enterprise.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on the Data Cloud team, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier data solutions and production-grade reality for customers. You will function as an "innovator-builder," working directly within customers’ environments to move data and machine learning workloads from idea to production on Google Cloud, leveraging experience with programming languages (e.g. PySpark, SQL, Python) and the data cloud ecosystem (e.g. BigQuery, Managed Spark, Spanner, AlloyDB). You will build the data foundations that agents depend on, and train and evaluate machine learning models on customer data. By embedding with strategic accounts, you serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Build and ship production data and machine learning workloads with customers, writing, testing, and performance-tuning PySpark, SQL and Python on BigQuery, Managed Spark, Spanner and AlloyDB.
  • Present working proofs with customers’ data, including de-identifying sensitive data (e.g., PCI, PHI).
  • Build the data foundation for agentic solutions, including lakehouse architectures, metadata, semantic context, and the access controls that let custom agents act on trusted data.
  • Train, evaluate and deploy machine learning and agentic components where they improve the customer’s business metric, with evaluation and monitoring in place.
  • Refactor and migrate high-cost analytics, Spark and operational database workloads from other platforms onto Google Cloud engines, with measured price-performance results.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, machine learning, or technical consulting, including coding experience in Python and SQL.
  • Experience with data cloud ecosystem products, technologies, or languages (e.g., Apache Spark, PySpark, BigQuery, Spanner, Data Catalog, and AlloyDB).
  • Experience taking production-grade data cloud solutions from conception to launch, including architecting data systems on cloud platforms (e.g., GCP) and building structured/unstructured pipelines.
  • Experience training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in production.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
  • Experience in prompt developing, model evaluation, and the creative application of AI.
  • Experience building applications on large language models (LLM) over enterprise data (e.g., Gemini, agents, RAG, vector search) and evaluating them for quality, latency and cost.
  • Experience migrating analytics, Spark or database workloads between platforms with measured cost or performance outcomes.
  • Knowledge of LLM-native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

title: Security Engineer, Red Team
descriptionHtml:
Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

As Google's products and infrastructure operate at a massive scale, we need to anticipate and counter sophisticated adversaries targeting Google and our users. Within Google's Red Team, our team combines offensive security tradecraft with software and AI systems engineering to scale how Google conducts red teaming.

In this role, you will build and operate offensive security capabilities, adversary tooling, and AI-assisted red-teaming systems, while also planning and executing targeted offensive security efforts to benefit Google's security posture. You will turn real-world attack chains and Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) into reliable, reusable offensive tooling, working closely with defenders and engineering teams to test detection coverage and deliver defense-in-depth improvements.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain offensive security capabilities, Command and Control (C2) tooling, and automated/agent-driven attack modules in Python and Go to test Google's infrastructure at scale.
  • Plan and execute realistic, scenario-based offensive security exercises and Red Team operations against Google's production, corporate, cloud, and AI systems in strict compliance with Rules of Engagement.
  • Convert proven real-world attack paths and adversary TTPs into safe, reliable, and reusable offensive modules and automation.
  • Partner closely with Detection and Response (Blue Teams) and affected product and infrastructure teams to test monitoring and defense mechanisms, verify detection coverage, and drive defense-in-depth engineering improvements.
  • Perform technical security assessments, code audits, and vulnerability research, and document and present findings to audiences ranging from technical engineers to executive leadership.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with security assessments or security design reviews or threat modeling.
  • 2 years of experience with security engineering, computer and network security and security protocols.
  • 2 years of coding experience in one or more general purpose languages.
  • Experience in offensive security, such as red teaming, penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, or offensive security tooling development.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or an extensive professional track record in offensive security and red teaming.
  • Experience building custom offensive security tools, Command and Control (C2) infrastructure, or AI-assisted security automation.
  • In-depth knowledge of cloud environments, distributed systems, authentication protocols, or AI/ML system security.
  • Familiarity with Detection and Response (Blue Team) concepts and conducting adversary simulations safely in production environments.
  • Being able to clearly and concisely articulate complex technical findings, risks, and remediation strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Unified Traffic Engineering, Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Unified Traffic Engineering (UTE) is responsible for optimized routing and traffic load balancing across Google's global networks, including B4 and the Google Global Network (GGN). Network traffic engineering is a critical infrastructure service; our systems deliver every network flow for Google and GCP end-to-end.

Our core goals include: guaranteeing four nines of network availability through fault-tolerant, outage-free system designs, delivering deterministic, policy-compliant, and latency-bounded packet forwarding. Reducing per-byte costs via novel traffic engineering algorithms and tight integration with capacity planning.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

title: Control Electronics Engineering Manager, Neutral Atoms, Quantum AI
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you will be a leader in a cross-functional team working to implement quantum computers using neutral-atom-based quantum processors. You will be involved in all stages of the electronics product lifecycle for these systems. You will work with cross-functional stakeholders to understand the electronic control requirements of neutral-atom quantum computers and use this knowledge to architect optimum control electronics that meet these requirements. You will own the implementation cycle of these electronics collaborating with colleagues within the quantum team’s electronics org and/or with vendors to realize robust systems. You will lead the test and bring-up of developed electronics and support their use in experimental systems.

The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large-scale computer capable of complex, error-corrected computations. Google Quantum AI's mission is to build this computer and unlock solutions to classically intractable problems. Our roadmap is focused on advancing the capabilities of quantum computing and enabling meaningful applications.

title: AI Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:

Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

In this role, you will partner with technical business teams to differentiate Google Cloud to the customers. You will serve as the technical authority on integrating Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) into enterprise environments, moving beyond simple chat interfaces to architecting secure and data-connected solutions. You will engage with customers to understand their business and technical requirements, and present solutions on Google Cloud. You will blend market knowledge and technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud AI portfolio.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Combine business strategies with direct development and prototyping to provide functional, customer-tailored solutions that secure buy-in from customer domain experts.
  • Provide technical consultation to customers on enterprise AI integration patterns, act as a technical advisor and build customer relationships.
  • Work with Google Cloud products to demonstrate and prototype integrations in customer and partner environments. Work within Product and Engineering management systems to document, prioritize, and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues.
  • Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as needed, and act as a public advocate for Google Cloud.
  • Drive the technical win for workloads within Gemini Enterprise to ensure adoption, support the business cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp, recommend integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to successfully implement a complete solution on Google Cloud.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience with cloud-native architecture in a customer-facing or support role, with application development and integration.
  • Experience with search systems including retrieval, ranking, and search quality tuning.
  • Experience with presenting to technical stakeholders and executive leaders.
  • Experience with coding in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, Go, or Java, to demo, prototype, or workshop integration patterns with customers.
  • Experience in architecting solutions that integrate AI models using agents with enterprise data sources using patterns like RAG, Text-to-SQL, and semantic search.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with functional evaluation metrics used to assess model quality and agent quality.
  • Experience with iPaaS, API gateways, or enterprise service buses (ESBs) in a cloud environment.
  • Experience developing agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, semantic kernel, or the Google AI agent development kit (ADK).
  • Knowledge of observability constructs including distributed tracing, logging, and audit logging for AI applications.
  • Knowledge of application integration governance and security, including OAuth2 flows and short-lived credential management.
  • Understanding of integration patterns using OpenAPI and model context protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents with business systems and API gateways.

title: Chuyên viên phụ trách chiến lược tài khoản, Phân khúc doanh nghiệp vừa và nhỏ, Nhóm Giải pháp khách hàng của Google
locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để phát triển trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn mang trong mình niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng gặt hái được nhiều thành công nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google lẫn khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, tìm hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và dựa vào đó để xây dựng các giải pháp hiệu quả giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu tham vọng nhất. Bạn gặt hái thành công cùng đội ngũ bán hàng, định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo dấu ấn thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Đội ngũ bán hàng thuộc Nhóm Giải pháp khách hàng của Google (GCS) gồm các chuyên viên tư vấn đáng tin cậy và đại diện bán hàng có năng lực cao, luôn tập trung vào việc hỗ trợ khách hàng đạt thành công bằng cách mang những dịch vụ tốt nhất của Google đến với các doanh nghiệp vừa và nhỏ (SMB) — một phần không thể thiếu trong cộng đồng của chúng tôi. Là một thành viên trong nhóm, bạn sẽ có cơ hội làm việc với các chủ doanh nghiệp, góp phần tạo nên sự khác biệt thực sự cho doanh nghiệp bằng cách hỗ trợ họ phát triển. Cùng nhau, chúng ta sẽ giúp định hình một tương lai đổi mới cho các khách hàng, đối tác và đại diện bán hàng... cũng như tận hưởng hành trình đó.

Responsibilities

  • Quản lý một danh mục gồm những doanh nghiệp quy mô trung bình bằng cách tìm hiểu các yếu tố thúc đẩy tăng trưởng, xác định cơ hội tăng trưởng, quản lý rủi ro và xây dựng kế hoạch để đạt được mục đích.
  • Cộng tác với các thành viên nhóm bán hàng, thống nhất quy trình làm việc giữa các thành viên trong nhóm để thực thi kế hoạch cũng như đảm bảo trách nhiệm giải trình nhằm đạt hoặc vượt mục tiêu đề ra, đồng thời mang lại trải nghiệm vượt trội cho khách hàng.
  • Thắt chặt mối quan hệ với khách hàng và đưa ra những đề xuất nhằm nâng cao hiệu suất. Gọi điện trao đổi nhằm thiết lập mối quan hệ và làm việc với các khách hàng hiện có để tạo đà tăng trưởng và giúp khách hàng thành công hơn nữa.
  • Xác định các bên liên quan chính của khách hàng để hỗ trợ khách hàng đạt được mục tiêu kinh doanh đề ra và định hình kế hoạch tiếp thị kỹ thuật số hằng năm. Đánh giá và giải quyết nhu cầu của khách hàng thông qua phương thức đặt câu hỏi, xử lý phản đối và bán hàng cạnh tranh một cách hiệu quả.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực quảng cáo kỹ thuật số, bán hàng qua hình thức tư vấn, kinh doanh truyền thông kỹ thuật số, phát triển kinh doanh, môi trường truyền thông trực tuyến, hoặc tiếp thị kỹ thuật số.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Có kinh nghiệm trong mảng công nghệ, quản lý khách hàng chiến lược cũng như kinh nghiệm hoàn thành chỉ tiêu để thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của khách hàng.
  • Khả năng đánh giá và đáp ứng nhu cầu của khách hàng bằng cách thực hiện hiệu quả việc đặt câu hỏi, xử lý phản đối và chiến lược bán hàng cạnh tranh.
  • Khả năng áp dụng kỹ năng phân tích để khai thác tối đa dữ liệu nhằm tìm ra thông tin chuyên sâu hỗ trợ cho việc đưa ra đề xuất và phân tích tác động.
  • Khả năng quản lý nhiều dự án cùng lúc mà vẫn nắm được thông tin chi tiết, cũng như khả năng làm việc độc lập và phối hợp với người khác.
  • Xuất sắc trong kỹ năng thuyết trình và giao tiếp với đồng nghiệp, đội ngũ quản lý, các phòng ban liên ngành và khách hàng.

We think everyone in the world should have access to the best computing has to offer. We provide the platform for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and developers to build compelling computing devices (smartphones, tablets, TVs, wearables, etc) that run the best apps/services for everyone in the world.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Infra, Ads Quality Infrastructure, Dynamo, Google Ads
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead architectural improvements for next-generation incremental data infrastructure, focusing on reducing system complexity and improving reliability.
  • Design and build highly scalable systems, architecting distributed data processing pipelines that extract and transform massive datasets to power advertising serving systems.
  • Drive software engineering best practices and system design while mentoring team members and ensuring production health.
  • Develop and scale frameworks that support artificial intelligence and machine learning workloads, including offline embedding generation and model inference.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to optimize how product and offer metadata is indexed and served with low latency.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 5 years of experience building and developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage, or hardware architecture.
  • Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, with a focus on scalability, fault tolerance, and reliability.
  • Experience in low-level systems programming languages (e.g., C++ or C).
  • Experience designing and implementing infrastructure solutions.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
  • Experience in C++ and distributed backend systems architecting solutions that process massive datasets at low latency.
  • Experience building data extraction and transformation platforms or working with machine learning infrastructure.
  • Experience working across engineering domains including e-commerce, shopping, or digital advertising.
  • Experience modernizing legacy architecture, driving migrations, and ensuring production reliability with cross-functional partner teams.
